branching.backward_trigger: 3 or fewer correct out of 5 (the game's Financial Literacy setting backwardWhenIncorrectAtLeast: 2). This package does not change the threshold; it is enforced by the game.
branching.on_trigger: The student works every backward section of the set in package order (B1, B2, ...), each passed with 5 correct in a row (existing rule), then returns to a fresh MAIN attempt.
branching.four_correct: a fresh set of the same skill (existing rule)
branching.five_correct: mastered; Go Deeper sections unlock (forward chain F1 -> F2 -> ...)

backward_kinds.concept: the course's own five questions on a simpler money idea
backward_kinds.math: a link to an existing math MAIN skill in the game (no questions in this package)

grading_rules: Every question is multiple choice with four choices, A-D, and exactly one correct letter.
The game may shuffle the choices; feedback and misconception notes never refer to a letter.
intro is shown above the question on the same screen before answering; feedback only after answering.
Questions without intro are knowledge checks of ideas taught earlier.
standards: Alignment: 2021 National Standards for Personal Financial Education (topic level; 12th-grade outcome codes only where verified) and NJSLS-CLKS 2020 Standard 9.1 (grade-12 strand level). See COVERAGE.md.
